scope: Independent manual review of the six final UI answers, source passages, task outcomes and execution records against the unchanged 18 declared checks. No new model calls or criteria changes.

criteria_reviews.check: Explains the three roles using cited documentation.
criteria_reviews.reason: The delivered four-bullet partial covers Ops/Calls and evaluations but omits Signals entirely, so it does not explain all three roles.

criteria_reviews.check: Signals are described as scoring completed turns.
criteria_reviews.reason: The delivered answer contains no Signal timing statement. Its earlier rejected draft had completed-turn timing; that draft is not the answer released to the user.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not promise monitoring will prevent or prove errors.
criteria_reviews.reason: The partial makes no promise that monitoring prevents or proves errors.
Uses the same conversation and actual preceding user/assistant context; retained Weave evidence supports the direct follow-up.

criteria_reviews.check: Separates after-completion monitoring from an in-agent release check.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explains root-span completion and weave.genai.turn_ended using S12, then separates inline guardrails and application control flow using S16. It does not generalize remote-scorer HTTP/retry behavior.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not claim a Signal guarantees safety.
criteria_reviews.reason: Describes review/flagging and inline checks without claiming a Signal guarantees safety.

criteria_reviews.check: Gives current conversation/turn and model/tool instrumentation guidance.
criteria_reviews.reason: Gives initialization, conversation/turn grouping, per-turn traces, and model/tool instrumentation guidance supported by the quickstart and trace-agents pages.

criteria_reviews.check: Separates trace grouping from actual conversation history; any tool-result example preserves preceding assistant tool calls.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explicitly separates trace grouping from resending history. Exact offline fake execution preserves prior user/assistant messages across two turns. Tool instrumentation is commented scaffolding; no tool-result example is supplied or protocol path claimed tested.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not claim unexecuted Weave integrations were executed.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explicitly calls the snippet illustrative and unrun, and identifies call_model/run_tool as application placeholders.

criteria_reviews.check: Explains dataset fields, prediction and scorer mapping.
criteria_reviews.reason: Maps task_id/user_request/success_criteria to agent execution and transcript judging, then records the reply and task-completion score on each prediction.

criteria_reviews.check: Includes a usable documented evaluation invocation.
criteria_reviews.reason: Shows the documented EvaluationLogger/log_prediction/log_score/log_summary invocation. Helper implementations and imports still need application setup; this is a guided snippet rather than a standalone runnable program.

criteria_reviews.check: Explains a judge rubric without treating its verdict as certain.
criteria_reviews.reason: Explains a success-criteria rubric over request and transcript, with passed/reason as the judge's verdict and no certainty claim. It does not explicitly teach judge fallibility; that omission is retained as a limitation, not a new criterion.

criteria_reviews.check: Does not present the invented API as real.
criteria_reviews.reason: Declines to supply weave.enable_hallucination_free_mode syntax and limits the search claim to the stored documentation snapshot.
Rejects the never-hallucinate guarantee and distinguishes output detection from prevention.

criteria_reviews.check: Offers relevant documented alternatives with source citations.
criteria_reviews.reason: Cites documented HallucinationFreeScorer and WeaveHallucinationScorerV1 alternatives and a source-derived evaluation example.

criteria_reviews.check: Actually invokes run_python and records successful execution.
criteria_reviews.reason: Saved actions include one successful run_python call with exit_code=0 and execution receipt C1; this is offline standard-library execution.

criteria_reviews.check: Calculates 2/4 = 0.5 and cites the execution receipt.
criteria_reviews.reason: Reports and cites C1's [True, False, True, False] results and 2/4=0.5 for the requested lists.

criteria_reviews.check: Connects deterministic scoring to documented Evaluation behavior without claiming a live Weave integration test.
criteria_reviews.reason: Connects per-row output/expected matching to Evaluation and documented boolean summarization, while explicitly labeling the Weave sketch untested and its model/dataset placeholders.

source_review: Read the cited passages behind all six final answers. Shared API/lifecycle semantics on an integration or remote-scorer page are assessed by their actual text, not rejected solely by page domain. No retained-answer source-authority defect was found in the declared checks.

overview_failure.delivered: Honest supported partial with six unresolved outcomes, including all Signals facets; not a complete explanation.
overview_failure.mechanism: The first draft had all nine facets and completed-turn timing. Its audit rejected a real Agent Lens attribution issue and also questioned shared lifecycle scope. No validated repair request survived; the eighteenth tool action was submission after seventeen research actions. Fresh recovery retained only four clauses.
overview_failure.interpretation: Correct incomplete status and Signal eligibility do not compensate for the failed user task. This run does not establish an underlying quality fix.

limitations: Six reused development tasks are not held-out evidence or a general reliability/latency estimate.
The overview fails two unchanged checks; runtime verification_passed means retained source support, not completion.
The tracing sketch's history was executed with offline fakes only. Its tool instrumentation remains commented scaffolding; no tool-result protocol or installed SDK/provider integration was exercised.
The evaluation explanation uses a documented helper-based snippet and does not explicitly discuss judge fallibility. Imports/helper implementations and provider setup remain user work.
Source-faithful examples are not automatically compatible with every SDK version; no unrequested remote example execution was performed.
Browser observations belong to browser.json. This review does not claim a new browser replay.
Costs are returned-usage estimates for UI agent work and exclude online Signal worker charges.
